title: Clean Seed: Scion learns only from matched, reviewable evidence

local: npx vitest run tests/scion-preference-gate.test.js tests/scion-adapter-tooling.test.js tests/scion-adapter-manifest.test.js tests/scion-adapter-registry.test.js

ciFast.note: Fast verification must pass on the exact v0.16.9 release head before merge.

ciDeep.note: The release exercises input matching, campaign integrity, domain-balanced research-tier manifests, group-stratified splits, and fail-closed ingestion locally. A real local-browser smoke also verified the 40-case form shape, native incomplete-field validation, draft persistence across reload, digest-bound JSON download, and zero auxiliary network requests. No completed instructor review or trained research adapter is claimed.

deploy.note: GitHub Pages deploys only after Fast verification succeeds on main.

liveProvider.note: This release changes offline corpus and training gates rather than hosted inference behavior; public Scion remains the verified browser-local base-only route.

manualHuman.note: The frozen campaign requires 320 independent instructor judgments. Zero have been ingested, and no human-preference or learned-quality claim is made.

claims.summary: Neutral training candidates require exact canonical course-input identity and bind both source artifacts; the audit excludes the mismatched World Literature pair and uses an explicit generic-title fallback for byte-identical Music Theory runs.

A 160-case, four-domain instructor campaign is disjoint from the frozen held-out benchmark and binds every randomized case, packet, source ledger, and organizer mapping; ingestion recomputes those identities and atomically accumulates domain batches without erasure or duplication.

A research-ready dataset requires 100 blind-instructor-approved pairs with at least 20 in each of four domains plus twelve isolated course groups, uses domain-stratified group splits, and carries the per-domain evidence and split distribution into non-promotable research adapter manifests; public candidate requirements remain stricter.

The review campaign is ready but has zero completed judgments, so research and production training remain blocked and public Scion continues to use the pinned browser-local Gemma base plus the model-neutral compiler.
